//: Deploying the portal — the React application only.
The API is not here. It is an Express server holding PostgreSQL connections
and serving uploaded files; it runs on a Node host, and this site is told
where to find it with VITE_API_URL at build time. See README.
This repository is an npm workspace, so the build runs the web workspace and
the output is web/dist rather than the `public` Vercel looks for by default.

rewrites.//: The portal resolves its own routes: /admin/students is not a file on disk, so anything that is not a real file returns index.html. /api and /uploads are deliberately excluded — they belong to the API, and answering them with the application's HTML would turn a clear failure into a baffling one, since the portal would try to read a web page as data.
